newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks dip slightly, consolidate gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks dip slightly, consolidate gains.

text.p: Wall Street shares eased slightly in mixed morning trade on Thursday, consolidating some of its recent gains following Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony on the economy.
The Dow Jones Industrial average, which made stunning gains on Tuesday after Greenspan's Humphrey Hawkins testimony, dipped 16 points to 8,073 in early trade.
The Nasdaq composite also softened three points to 1,564.
"The market certainly needs a consolidation after moving up so sharply this year," Arnold Kaufman, editor of Standard & Poor's Outlook investment advisory news letter, said.
